integrity: The all-parameter statements are supplied with an analytic proof and rational finite-size reproduction. Earlier results on local curvature or other graph families are not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: No weighted or degree-normalized generator, higher Wasserstein distances, or graphs outside the crown family are classified; publication priority is not exhaustively established, and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_scope: Crown graphs on 2n vertices for every integer n>=3, shortest-path Wasserstein-1, continuous-time semigroup generated by the combinatorial graph Laplacian, counting measure, all times t>=0.
title: Exact all-time heat transport on crown graphs, with a six-cycle exception
